Case: Password step UI is rendered correctly when user arrives from the email consent step
Description:
• Pre-condition: User has completed step 1 (email + consent) and is redirected to sso.sleekflow.io/u/signup/password.
  • Source: sleekflow-login-signup-003 · AC1
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the sign-up flow and complete the email + consent step.
  2. Observe the password step (step 2) page layout.
  3. Inspect the email field, password field, show/hide toggle, and password checklist.
Expected:
• Email address from step 1 is displayed in a read-only field.
  • An "Edit" link is visible next to the email field.
  • A password input field with autocomplete="new-password" is present.
  • A show/hide toggle button is visible on the password field.
  • A checklist labelled "Your password must contain:" is visible with 5 items: at least 8 characters, lowercase letter, uppercase letter, number, special character.
BDD: Given the user has completed the email consent step, When the password step page loads, Then all UI elements (read-only email, Edit link, password field, show/hide toggle, and 5-item checklist) are displayed

Case: Real-time password checklist updates when user types in the password field
Description:
• Pre-condition: User is on the password step (step 2) of sign-up.
  • Source: sleekflow-login-signup-003 · AC1
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the password step.
  2. Click the password field.
  3. Type a single lowercase letter (e.g., "a").
  4. Observe which checklist items are marked.
  5. Continue typing to satisfy each criterion one by one (add uppercase, digit, special character, reach 8+ chars).
  6. Observe checklist after each addition.
Expected:
• After typing "a": only "lowercase letter" criterion is marked as satisfied.
  • After adding an uppercase letter: "uppercase letter" criterion is additionally marked.
  • After adding a digit: "number" criterion is additionally marked.
  • After adding a special character: "special character" criterion is additionally marked.
  • After reaching 8 characters: "at least 8 characters" criterion is additionally marked.
  • All updates occur without page reload (real-time/inline).
BDD: Given the user is on the password step, When the user types characters into the password field, Then each checklist criterion updates in real time as the corresponding requirement is met

Case: Show/hide toggle reveals and masks password text when clicked
Description:
• Pre-condition: User is on the password step (step 2) of sign-up and has typed a password.
  • Source: sleekflow-login-signup-003 · AC1
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the password step.
  2. Type any password into the password field.
  3. Click the show/hide toggle button.
  4. Observe the password field input type.
  5. Click the toggle again.
  6. Observe the password field input type.
Expected:
• Initially, password text is masked (input type="password").
  • After first click: password text is revealed as plain text (input type="text").
  • After second click: password text is masked again.
BDD: Given the user has entered a password, When the show/hide toggle is clicked, Then the password visibility toggles between masked and revealed

Case: Password complexity rules applied by the product differ from Help Center documentation
Description:
• Pre-condition: Access to both the sign-up password step and the SleekFlow Help Center password rules page.
  • Source: sleekflow-login-signup-003 · AC7
  • Note (P1-7): REQUIREMENT CONTRADICTION — product enforces all 5 criteria; Help Center states "8 characters + any 3 of 4 types". This TC is flagged Manual until P1-7 is resolved.
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the password step and observe the checklist (5 criteria).
  2. Navigate to the SleekFlow Help Center page on password rules.
  3. Compare: product requires all 5 types vs Help Center "any 3 of 4".
  4. Attempt to submit a password that meets 3-of-4 criteria but NOT all 5 (e.g., no special character).
  5. Observe whether the product accepts or rejects the password.
Expected:
• EXPECTED (once P1-7 is resolved): product and Help Center describe the same password rules.
  • CURRENT STATE: product rejects password meeting only 3-of-4 criteria; Help Center would indicate it should be accepted.
  • TC should be updated to reflect the final rule after P1-7 decision.
BDD: Given the password step enforces 5 criteria and the Help Center states 3-of-4, When a user enters a password meeting 3-of-4 criteria, Then the product acceptance or rejection reveals the active rule (contradiction to be resolved per P1-7)
